# Rumble roster

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/rumble.yaml. Do not edit. -->

What Rumble mode offers: its **modes** (`CfgRumbleGame`), **arenas** (`CfgRumbleArena`, each with the modes it
allows), **gangs** (`CfgRumbleGang`, nine character types each) and **characters** (`CfgRumbleChar`: a type's gang,
rank and strength). Each is offered only while its [unlockable](unlockables.md) record is unlocked (a mode type 1,
an arena 2, a gang 3); a gang member whose character record (type 4) is still locked is replaced by a fixed stand-in
(`0x001ec490`). How the menus use them: [Front end: the Rumble data](../research/frontend.md#rumble-data). The
names, titles and descriptions are the game's text and are not listed.

!!! info "What is complete"

    All 9 modes, 29 arenas, 46 gangs and 366 characters are listed (the characters are set in four scripts, in two
    copies; both agree). A gang with a negative id is always offered. What an arena's second number does, and the
    characters' `+0x0e`, are not traced.

450 entries. Data: `research/references/rumble.yaml`.

## Sources and evidence

Evidence levels used: confirmed-code.

- rumble_data.lua, rumble_arena.lua, rumble_gang.lua and the Rumble character scripts

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | str | | `mode-<RM name>`, `arena-<level>`, `gang-<id>` or `char-<type>`. |
| `kind` | str | | `mode`, `arena`, `gang` or `character`. |
| `number` | int | | The mode's value, the arena's level number, the gang id or the character type. |
| `name` | str | | A mode's `RM_*` constant. |
| `one_player` | bool | | A mode offers one player against the computer. |
| `coop` | bool | | A mode offers two players together. |
| `versus` | bool | | A mode offers two players against each other. |
| `fighters` | int | | Fighters per side. |
| `presets` | list | | The character types a mode fills both sides with. |
| `value` | int | | An arena's second argument (9 in every call). |
| `modes` | list | | The modes an arena allows (`all` when its table starts with 0). |
| `members` | list | | A gang's nine character types. |
| `character` | int | | A character's type. |
| `model` | str | | Its model. |
| `gang` | int | | The gang id a character belongs to. |
| `rank` | str | | Its rank (`RM_WARCHIEF`, `RM_LT`, `RM_SOLDIER`, `RM_BOSS` ...). |
| `v0e` | int | | `CfgRumbleChar`'s sixth argument (16-bit `+0x0e`, 0 in every call). |
| `strength` | int | | Seventh argument (byte `+0x10`, 20-80): a strength rating (inferred). |
| `unlock` | int | | The unlockable record that gates it, when there is one. |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-workflow.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
